# Jonathan Telep

> Senior Software Engineer at Red Hat in Cleveland, Ohio. Founder of Telep IO, a solo side studio. Builds and ships independent products on the open internet.

Jonathan Telep (Jon) is a Senior Software Engineer at Red Hat. Through [Telep IO](https://telep.io) — a side studio, not a full-time employer — he ships public products and does the same kind of work for other people. The latest live product is sumvid. The thing he is building toward is [telep.tools](https://telep.tools), the public tool shipyard.

Work with him via [jonathantelep.com/request](https://jonathantelep.com/request), [telep.io/contact](https://telep.io/contact) (studio), [jon@telep.io](mailto:jon@telep.io), or [@telep_io](https://x.com/telep_io) on X.

## Work and products

- [Telep IO](https://telep.io): studio founded by Jonathan Telep
- [sumvid](https://sumvid.app): video summarization — paste a link, get the point (live)
- [telep.tools](https://telep.tools): one home for every tool he makes (in progress)
- [Easy Data Quality](https://easydataquality.com): data quality checks (live)
- [seploy](https://github.com/Telep-IO/seploy): deploy utility from local to live (live)
- [skills](https://github.com/JonTelep/skills): agent skills that make Claude better at specific jobs (live)
- [boards](https://telep.io/contact): image generation to video generation (in progress)
